evaluator.isolation: Separate cloud agent context with no access to the generator context or to gold labelling contexts.

files_read.purpose: Case inputs, recipient descriptions and image specs.
Freeze record used to verify the outputs hash.
Route, rating, question, revision and invariant definitions.

prohibited_files_not_accessed.category: holdout images; legibility taken from image_spec in cases.json

prohibited_files_not_accessed.path: gold labels for this holdout (any path)
mutation test files and mutation manifests (any path)
Git history, diffs, tags and pull requests

method_disclosures: Evaluation labels describe what each frozen output actually did: the route it took, the ratings it stated, the question topics it actually raised and the semantic facts its rewrite actually carries. No expected answers were consulted.

Ratings are null on Intake, Scope and Message-template routes; on rated routes the recorded overall equals the Red>Gray>Yellow>Green derivation from the recorded responsibility and tone, and each output's own stated overall was checked against that derivation.
critical_invariants carries all eight canonical keys on every turn, with true meaning the invariant held on that turn, including turns where it is vacuously satisfied.

fixed-format-or-valid-nonreview-route was judged as output well-formedness: the fixed review sections, or a complete Information-needed or Message-template block. Whether a non-review route was the correct choice for the case is recorded in the route field and rationale instead, so that route disagreements are not double-counted as critical failures.
Holdout images were not opened. Judgements about what is and is not legible rely on the image_spec visual_conditions and legibility_notes in cases.json.
Directory names under tests/blind were listed (names only, no file contents) so that prohibited paths could be enumerated precisely in this attestation.
Git was used only for branch creation, staging, commit and push on this branch. No log, diff, show, blame, tag or pull request inspection was performed.
No filesystem access log was available in this environment, so this attestation is self-reported rather than machine-audited.
